DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder) with suspected inflammatory component due to diabetes.

Based on your 2-month history of progressive stiffness, pain at night, and difficulty with overhead movements, combined with your diabetes and the likely imaging findings of joint space narrowing without fracture or dislocation, the clinical picture strongly suggests adhesive capsulitis. This condition is often associated with diabetes and can lead to a "frozen" shoulder if not managed properly. We will proceed with physical examination maneuvers to confirm the range of motion limitations typical of this diagnosis.
